senses.gloss: (b. h.;v. Ges. H. Dict.<sup>10</sup> s. vv. <he>חלל</he> I, II)

units: Ber. 32ᵃ (ref. to ייחל, Ex. XXXII, 11) שחַל עליהם מדת הדין למדת הרחמים Ms. M. (v. חָלָה) he (Moses) turned justice into mercy in their behalf; Yalk. Ex. 392 הֵחֵל (Hif.).—[Tanḥ. Yithro 1 מת חולל, read וחָלָל.]

senses.gloss: to bore, hollow, pierce, v. חָלִיל, חָלָל I. I.
to surround; to place outside a circle, v. חוֹל III, חִילּוֹנִי.
(v. חָלָל I) to be cut all around, be severed.
units: <cite ref="Nazir 54a:1">Naz. 54ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 19:18">Num. XIX, 18</cite>) <he>בחלל זה אבר הנ׳ מן החי וכ׳</he> ‘on something severed’, that means a limb which has been cut off a living body, and on which there was not flesh enough to have made healing possible; <he>במת זה אבר הנ׳ וכ׳</he> ‘on something dead’, that means a limb severed from a corpse; ib. 53ᵇ

senses.gloss: to become חוּלִּין, to cease to be sacred.
units: Shebi. I, 8 עד שיֵחוֹלּוּ until the fruits become available for private use; Y. ib. 33ᶜ top מהו עד שיח׳ עד שיפדו או עד שיעשו חולין וכ׳ what does ad sheyeḥôllu mean? Until they are redeemed (in the fourth year), or until they become ḥullin of themselves (in the fifth year)?
<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 134:5">Sifré Num. 134</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 3:24">Deut. III, 24</cite>) <he>אתה הֲחִילּוֹתָ וכ׳</he> thou hast begun to open the door &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Demai 7:4">Dem. VII, 4</cite> <he>ומֵיחֵל ושותה</he> Y. ed. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) and he may at once commence drinking (Maim.; v. infra).

senses.gloss: to make חוּלִּין; to break a vow; to profane. Ber. l. c. (ref. to Num. XXX, 3) הוא אינו מֵיחֵל אבל אחרים מְחַלִּין לו he himself cannot break a vow, but others may break it for him (absolve him; Ḥag. 10ᵃ … מיחל … מוֹחֲלִין; Ex. R. s. 43 מוחל אבל … חכם מוֹחֵל, corr. acc.). Dem. l. c. ומיחל ושותה and thus he redeems, and he may drink (R. S.); Tosef. ib. VIII, 7 ומ׳ ושותה מיד.—
units: Kidd. 77ᵃ (ref. to Lev. XXI, 15) מֵיחֵל he produces profanation (begets degraded priests), v. חָלָל II.—3) to turn, change.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 392">Yalk. Ex. 392</cite>, v. supra.

senses.gloss: to break a vow, to profane, to desecrate; to degrade.
units: <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2:8">Deut. R. s. 2</cite> (play on <he>החלת</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 3:24">Deut. III, 24</cite>) <he>חִלַּלְתָּ וכ׳</he> hast thou not broken the oath? (<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 134:5">Sifré Num. 134</cite> <he>הֲחִלּוֹתָ</he>, v. supra).
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:11">Ab. III, 11</cite> <he>המְחַלֵּל את הקדשים</he> who treats profanely sacred things (causes them to be carried out and burnt).
Ab. Zar. 28ᵃ מְחַלְּלִין עליה וכ׳ you may desecrate the Sabbath for the sake of curing it; a. fr.—Esp. to cause the loss of the priestly status.

<cite ref="Makkot 2a:7">Macc. 2ᵃ</cite> <he>המְחַלֵּל אינו מִתְחַלֵּל</he> he (the priest marrying a divorced woman) who causes the loss of priestly status (to his issue) does not lose the priestly status himself; <he>הבא לחַלֵּל ולא חִילֵּל</he> he who intended to cause the loss of priestly status (by false testimony) and did not succeed.
Deut. XIV, 24, sq.) to redeem, to make available for private use.
<cite ref="Mishnah Maaser Sheni 1:2">Maas. Sh. I, 2</cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be removed from the priestly status, become a חָלָל.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 77a:12">Kidd. 77ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 21:15">Lev. XXI, 15</cite> ‘he shall not degrade’) <he>לא יְחוּלָּל זה וכ׳</he> no degradation shall be caused—which can only refer to a person who had a status and now becomes degraded (i.e. his wife).

senses.gloss: to be redeemed, to become secular again. Part. מְחוּלָּל, f. מְחוּלֶּלֶת.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Demai 5:1">Dem. V, 1</cite>, a. fr. <he>ומח׳ על המעות</he> and it is redeemed by setting aside its value.

<cite ref="Mishnah Maaser Sheni 2:10">Maas. Sh. II, 10</cite> <he>מה … סלע זו ח׳ עליו</he> (not <he>על זו</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) this Sela (which has been set apart as an equivalent for second tithes) shall be redeemed against the wine which the clean (sons of mine) may drink in Jerusalem, i.e. I buy with this Sela only that portion of the wine which the clean may drink.
<cite ref="Mishnah Maaser Sheni 2:10">Ib.</cite> <he>הרי מעות האלו מְחוּלָּלִים וכ׳</he> that money (dedicated for purchasing equivalents in Jerusalem) shall be redeemed against thy fruits; a. v. fr.

senses.gloss: to be loosely joined, to be a movable link.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 52b:9">Sabb. 52ᵇ</cite> <he>במְחוּלָּלִין</he> referring to movable links, (v. <cite ref="H00347"><he>חוּלְיָא</he> I</cite>). Y. Pes. I, 27ᶜ top <he>במְחוּלָּלוֹת</he> when the vessels can be rolled about, opp. <he>אפוצות</he> close together (v. <cite ref="H01018"><he>חִלְחֵל</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 2:13">Esth. R. to I, 8</cite> <he>שיִתְחַלְּלוּ מעיו</he>.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:11">Ab. I, 11</cite>.
<cite ref="Makkot 2a:7">Macc. 2ᵃ</cite>, v. supra.
<cite ref="Yevamot 79a:7">Yeb. 79ᵃ</cite> <he>ואל יתְחַלֵּל וכ׳</he> rather than that the name of the Lord be profaned in public; a. fr.
